news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.36 loss per share (vs ₹1.49 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹2.36 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹1.49 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹20.0b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹1.68b (loss widened 58% from 3Q 2025). Revenue is expected to decline by 8.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Construction industry in India are expected to grow by 14%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 7% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 80% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
